setup: The prism has a base of area \([[base]]\) square units and a height of \([[height]]\) units.

steps.say: Every cross-section parallel to the base is congruent to it, which is what makes a prism a prism -- so the base area \([[base]]\) is the same at every level.
Stacking that area through the height \([[height]]\) multiplies the two: the volume is \([[base]] \times [[height]] = [[volume]]\).

answer: So the prism's volume is \([[volume]]\) cubic units.
